question: Bank of Russia decision in October?
resolution_criteria:
This market will resolve according to the change in the key rate resulting from the Bank of Russia’s October meeting, relative to the level it was prior to this meeting.

The resolution source for this market is information released by the Bank of Russia after its October 23, 2026 meeting as listed on the official Bank of Russia calendar: https://www.cbr.ru/eng/dkp/cal_mp/#t13

This market may resolve as soon as the Bank of Russia’s press release for their October 2026 meeting with relevant data is issued. If no decision on the key rate is issued by the end date of the next scheduled meeting, this market will resolve to the "No Change" bracket.
research:
I couldn't find anything published by 2026-10-04 that settles this. The latest evidence before that date points to holding the rate. The Bank of Russia kept the key rate at 14.00% on 2026-09-11, called it a "pause", gave no signal about its next step, and inflation was speeding up week to week in late September. Several search results were dated after 2026-10-04, so I left them out.

## 1. Resolution source
- 2026-10-04: The official Bank of Russia calendar lists the 2026 key rate meetings as 13 Feb, 20 Mar, 24 Apr, 19 Jun, 24 Jul, 11 Sep, **23 Oct** and 18 Dec. The page itself doesn't show the current rate. [CBR calendar](https://www.cbr.ru/eng/dkp/cal_mp/)
- 2026-09-11: The last decision held the key rate at **14.00%**, which is the level the October decision will be compared against. [CBR summary](https://cbr.ru/eng/dkp/mp_dec/decision_key_rate/summary_key_rate_23092026/)

## 2. Current status
- Nothing that settles the question had happened as of 2026-10-04. The decision is due on 2026-10-23.
- 2026-09-11: Governor Elvira Nabiullina said the board discussed "keeping the rate" and "did not substantively discuss a cut". She said the room for further cuts would be reassessed with the updated forecast in October, and that pro-inflation risks had grown and still dominated. [Kommersant](https://www.kommersant.ru/doc/8952812), [Vedomosti](https://www.vedomosti.ru/economics/news/2026/09/11/1228198-ne-obsuzhdal-snizhenie)

## 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-30: Weekly inflation for 22-28 September was 0.12%, up from 0.06% the week before and the highest since late July. Annual inflation was about 6.25-6.26%. Prices were up 4.93% year to date, against 4.29% a year earlier. [Profinance](https://www.profinance.ru/news2/2026/09/30/ckbe-nedelnaya-inflyatsiya-v-rossii-prodolzhaet-uskoryatsya.html), [Frank Media](https://frankmedia.ru/307595)
- 2026-09-29: The bank published its summary of the September board discussion. Highlights:
  - Participants reached a broad consensus that a pause was justified.
  - Annualised, seasonally adjusted price growth jumped to 11.6% in July (from 5.3% in Q2). Core inflation was 7.0%, and the underlying inflation estimate rose to 5-6%.
  - The main drivers were refinery and fuel disruptions, and to a limited extent a weaker ruble.
  - Before October the bank wanted more data on fuel prices, second-round effects (fuel costs feeding into other prices) and the budget.
  - It still forecasts 6-7% inflation for 2026.
  
  [CBR summary](https://cbr.ru/eng/dkp/mp_dec/decision_key_rate/summary_key_rate_23092026/)
- 2026-09-23: Weekly inflation was at its highest since the end of July. [Profinance](https://www.profinance.ru/news2/2026/09/23/cka6-nedelnaya-inflyatsiya-v-rossii-dostigla-maksimuma-s-kontsa-iyulya.html)
- 2026-09-17: Bank Saint Petersburg (BSPb) analysts said inflation had not slowed enough to resume cuts. [Profinance](https://www.profinance.ru/news2/2026/09/30/ckbe-nedelnaya-inflyatsiya-v-rossii-prodolzhaet-uskoryatsya.html)
- 2026-09-11: The hold was the first since June 2025. It came alongside Ukrainian drone strikes on refineries pushing up fuel prices, oil above $100, and annual inflation of 6.3% as of 7 September. Further cuts were tied to underlying inflation clearly cooling and the 2027 budget being finalised. [Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/09/11/russian-central-bank-holds-key-rate-at-14-a93688), [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-09-11/russia-holds-rate-for-first-time-in-15-months-on-inflation-risks)

## 4. Base rates
- 2026 decisions so far: 13 Feb to 20 Mar were cuts (20 Mar was 50 bp to 15.00%), then cuts through 24 Jul (25 bp, 14.25% to 14.00%), then a hold on 11 Sep. That is 6 cuts and 1 hold, with no hikes. [Moscow Times](https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2026/09/11/russian-central-bank-holds-key-rate-at-14-a93688)
- Easing had been slowing from larger steps to 25 bp. The bank had just paused and gave no signal for October.
- Since mid-2025 the bank has not raised rates. The last hikes were in the 2023-2024 tightening cycle, ending at 21%.
- October meetings bring an updated forecast, which the bank uses to reset its rate guidance. Nabiullina said explicitly that the room for cuts would be reassessed in October.

## 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-09-02: In the bank's analyst survey, the forecast 2026 average key rate stayed at 14.5%. The implied average for the rest of 2026 was 13.7%, meaning some cuts were still expected at that point. Forecasts for 2027 averaged 12.4%. The 2026 inflation forecast rose to 6.6%. [Moscow Times RU](https://ru.themoscowtimes.com/2026/09/02/analitiki-ozhidayut-klyuchevuyu-stavku-v-ostavshiesya-mesyatsy-26g-v-137-makroopros-tsbr-a205079)
- Polymarket runs a market called "Bank of Russia decision in October?". I couldn't find its price as of 2026-10-04: the only aggregator snapshot I found was from after that date, so I ignored it. [PredScope](https://predscope.com/event/bank-of-russia-decision-in-october-20260724021538830)
- SberCIB's scenarios: hold now and cut to 13.75% in December as the base case; a hike to 16% in the conservative case; 13% in the optimistic case. I couldn't confirm exactly when that page was dated. [SberCIB](https://sbercib.ru/publication/prognoz-klyuchevoi-stavki-na-2026-god)
- I found no Kalshi or Manifold market.

## 6. Upcoming events before 2026-10-23
- Rosstat weekly inflation releases (Wednesdays: about 8, 15 and 22 October). Regulated utility tariffs are indexed on 1 October, so expect a one-off jump that week.
- September monthly inflation from Rosstat (about 10 October).
- The government's 2027-2029 draft budget goes to the State Duma (late September or early October). The bank named the budget as a key input.
- The bank's October analyst survey (mid-October), and data on household and business inflation expectations.
- Fuel prices and the ruble exchange rate, plus any new refinery strikes.
- 2026-10-23: Board decision, updated forecast and new rate guidance.
